strings.en: Never saw his Pokémon

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你弟弟上次跟我战斗时{NEWLINE}对赫拉克罗斯的指挥技巧很棒,{CLEAR}在他这个年龄段已经非常出彩了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: When your brother battled{NEWLINE}me, he commanded Heracross really well.{CLEAR}For his age, he’s already outstanding.

strings.zh: 谢谢冠军大人{NEWLINE}以亲身经历教育舍弟,{CLEAR}让他看到了与精灵一起成长的重要性。
strings.en: Thank you, Champion, for teaching my{NEWLINE}little brother with your own experience{CLEAR}and showing him how important it{CLEAR}is to grow together with Pokémon.

strings.zh: 偶像,我以后会好好锻炼我的精灵,{NEWLINE}等我成为精英训练家之后,{CLEAR}你要再跟我比试一次哦。
strings.en: Idol, I’m going to train my Pokémon{NEWLINE}properly from now on. Once I’m an{CLEAR}Ace Trainer, battle me again, OK?

strings.zh: 我的狃拉虽然暂时还很弱小,{NEWLINE}但经过锻炼之后,{CLEAR}它一定可以成长为强大的精灵。
strings.en: My Sneasel is still weak for now,{NEWLINE}but with training, it’s sure to{CLEAR}grow into a strong Pokémon.

strings.zh: 哈哈,那边草丛里的皮卡丘{NEWLINE}是我朋友假扮的。{CLEAR}怎么样,一开始没想到吧？
strings.en: Ha ha! The Pikachu in the grass over{NEWLINE}there is my friend in disguise. Well?{CLEAR}Didn’t see that coming, did you?

strings.zh: 你看到了吗？{NEWLINE}湖中心的草坪上有一只皮卡丘！{CLEAR}那可是在城都地区非常少见的精灵。{SCROLL}你如果会冲浪术的话,{NEWLINE}就游过去把它收服吧！
strings.en: Did you see? There’s a Pikachu{NEWLINE}on the patch of grass in the{CLEAR}middle of the lake! That’s a{CLEAR}really rare Pokémon in Johto.{SCROLL}If you know Surf, swim{NEWLINE}over and catch it!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,把自己伪装成皮卡丘,{NEWLINE}吓路过的训练家一大跳！
strings.en: Heh heh. I disguise myself as a Pikachu{NEWLINE}and give passing Trainers a big scare!

strings.zh: 皮卡丘『哟,路过的训练家呀,{NEWLINE}你是为了我这只皮卡丘而来的吗？{SCROLL}皮卡丘『既然如此,那就来打一架吧！
strings.en: Pikachu: Yo, passing Trainer! Did{NEWLINE}you come here for me, this Pikachu?{SCROLL}Pikachu: In that case, let’s fight!

strings.zh: 哎呀呀,变装之后搞突然袭击{NEWLINE}都没能打赢你。{CLEAR}看来你蛮厉害的嘛。
strings.en: Oh my. Even a surprise attack{NEWLINE}in disguise couldn’t beat you.{CLEAR}You’re pretty good, huh?

strings.zh: 啊,啊！都是因为你来打扰,{NEWLINE}蚊香蝌蚪逃掉了。{CLEAR}你要怎么陪我啊！
strings.en: Aaah! Because you disturbed me,{NEWLINE}the Poliwag got away. How are{CLEAR}you going to make it up to me?!

strings.zh: 逃掉的蚊香蝌蚪很大的,{NEWLINE}大概有25米的说……
strings.en: The Poliwag that got away was huge.{NEWLINE}It was about 25 meters long...
